headline: Israel Vote Is Likeliest to End in Coalition Bargaining
deck: Foreman puts a 75% chance on official results leaving both blocs below 61 and a coalition-builder named within seven days; either a 61-seat bloc or no designation settles NO.
body: Israelis voted Tuesday in a national election widely seen as a referendum on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s leadership after the Hamas-led October 7, 2023 attack and the wars that followed. [E1]
More than 7.3 million Israelis were eligible to vote, according to Israel’s Central Election Committee. [E2]
Most of Israel’s roughly 12,000 polling stations were due to close at 10 p.m., after which ballots would be counted manually at each station. [E3]
Channel 13’s final poll put Gadi Eisenkot’s change bloc on 54 seats, Netanyahu’s parties on 50 and Arab parties on 16. [E4]
The same projection left both main blocs short of a Knesset majority. [E5]

Within seven days of the official announcement of election results, the president consults elected blocs and assigns the government-formation task to a party leader with enough support for a viable coalition, Israel Policy Forum said. [E6]

**The desk's reading.** The desk assigns a 75% probability that post-vote coalition bargaining follows the official result. It starts from a neutral 50% prior. The final poll moves the estimate because neither main bloc reaches the majority threshold in the projection and the 16 projected Arab-party seats create a negotiating pivot. The strongest competing reading is that late vote movement gives one bloc an outright majority, ending that bargaining before it starts.

**The next test.** The call settles YES if the official result leaves both main blocs below 61 seats and, within seven days of the official announcement, the president assigns the government-formation task to a leader with enough support for a viable coalition. It settles NO if either bloc reaches that threshold or no such designation is made in that period.

confidence.label: Both blocs below 61; coalition-builder named in 7 days, otherwise NO
